settings.about: Interest rates and flat fees are defaults to be checked and are not legal advice.
settings.backup.confirm: The current data will be replaced by the backup (the old state is saved first). Continue?
settings.backup.hint: The backup contains the database and all documents as a ZIP file.
settings.demo.confirm: Data already exists. Load demo data in addition anyway?
settings.demo.hint: Fills the application with invented sample data so that you can try all functions.

settings.pin.recovery: Forgot the PIN? Close the application and start it from the command prompt with “SupplierAppConsole.exe --reset-pin” (see README).

settings.tesseract.no_german: The German language data (deu) is missing – recognition will be worse.

supplier.name: Name

org.assign.title: Change assignment
org.delete.confirm: Really delete the entry? This is only possible if no invoices, payments or documents are assigned to it.
org.hint: Create your companies and assign hotels to them. Invoices, payments and documents can be assigned to a hotel (the company follows automatically) or to a company only. The “View” selector at the top filters the whole app.
org.name: Name
org.scope.tooltip: All companies, one company (with all its hotels) or a single hotel – applies to all areas of the app
org.select_company: Please select a company (or a hotel of that company) in the list first.
org.title: Companies & hotels
payment.scope.tip: Leave empty: the assignment follows from the paid invoices. Only relevant for unallocated credit.
review.due_plus.hint: The day buttons count from the invoice date or the reminder date.
settings.vocab.hint: Recognition already knows many terms (Rechnung, Beleg, Faktura, Facture, Fattura …, net/gross, total/sum, VAT …). If a supplier uses a different word, enter it here (separate several with commas). Takes effect on the next import or when you review again.
settings.vocab.invoice_title: Title of an invoice (e.g. supplier statement)
settings.vocab.net: Net amount (e.g. value of goods without tax)
conn.title: Database connection
conn.intro: Single PC: the data is on this PC. Multi-user: the data is on a PostgreSQL server, several users work with the same data at the same time (everyone signs in with their own user name).
conn.local: Single PC – data on this PC (SQLite)
conn.server: Multi-user – data on a PostgreSQL server
login.title: Sign in
login.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
login.unlock.title: Locked
login.unlock.text: The application is locked. Please enter your password.
login.first.title: Create administrator
login.first.text: There are no users yet. Create the first user (administrator) now. The administrator adds further users later under Settings → Users.
user.role.hint: Administrator: everything incl. users and server. Editor: import documents, book, reports. Read-only: view and print only.
settings.database.local:
Single PC – the data is on this PC:
{path}
settings.database.server: Multi-user – the data is on the server {server}. Several users can work at the same time; colleagues' changes appear automatically.
settings.database.transfer.confirm: All data and documents of this PC will be copied to the empty server {server}. The local data remains unchanged. The application then starts in multi-user mode (first start: create administrator). Continue?
settings.database.transfer.done: The data was transferred ({n} records). The application will now close; sign in to the server at the next start.
settings.database.restart: The setting was saved. The application will now close; please start it again.
settings.database.hint: Multi-user operation requires a PostgreSQL server in the company network (see the instructions in the README).
settings.users.hint: Only administrators see this list. Locked users cannot sign in; a user is never deleted if they are the last administrator.
conn.shared.hint: All users use the same folder (network drive of a PC that is always on). Use Windows network shares only – no cloud folders (OneDrive, Dropbox …). The app backs up the database daily to the subfolder “backups\auto”. For more than 3–5 simultaneous users a server (PostgreSQL) is safer.
settings.database.shared: Multi-user (shared folder) – the data is in the folder {path}. Several users can work at the same time; bookings are processed one after the other, colleagues' changes appear automatically.
settings.database.transfer_shared: Transfer data to a shared folder …
settings.database.transfer_shared.confir: All data and documents of this PC will be copied to the (empty) folder {path}. The local data remains unchanged. The application then works in multi-user mode with this folder (first start: create administrator). Continue?
settings.database.transfer_shared.done: The data was copied ({n} files). The application will now close; sign in at the next start. On the other PCs: Settings → Change connection → shared folder.
settings.database.all_pcs.done: Saved in {path}. Every PC that starts the program from this program folder now uses the shared data folder automatically (only signing in is still needed).
settings.language.hint: The interface language is saved for this PC and applies from the next start.
settings.language.restart: The language changes at the next start. Restart now?
settings.language.later: The language will change the next time you start the application.

party.suggestion_hint: Suggestion from the document ({pct} %): {reasons}. Please check.
